title: CmdPal: primary context menu item has no icon when the command doesn’t set one

judgment.rationale: The report has concrete reproduction and existing upstream ownership. Preserve the covering candidate and validate the reported behavior and its controls rather than create a competing implementation or request an unnecessary diagnostics archive.
judgment.recommended_action: Review and verify the existing open candidate51925; retain this issue until a confirmed repair is available.
evidence: The reporter supplies0.102 and exact Run page/notepad/context-menu steps; no additional logs are needed to identify the missing icon.
The issue timeline links open51925, whose description explicitly closes51923.
The candidate refreshes the primary command icon after asynchronous icon initialization and falls back to the list-item icon when the command has no actual icon content.
Added tests cover command-icon precedence and list-item fallback. These tests were read, not claimed executed here.
